name: kv-sermon-plugin
description: KV Sermon Plugin Stage 6 regression candidate: passage-governed sermon construction and revision with bounded KV sermon support skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build passage-governed sermons with bounded KV sermon support skills.
interface.longDescription: Faithful sermon construction and revision from approved study or sermon material, with supporting skills for study-to-sermon handoff, sermon audit, passage faithfulness, source transparency, Scripture formatting, multi-asset scope control, sermon listening guides, one-page handouts, and print-ready packet polish. Full upstream passage study remains owned by the separate KV Study Plugin.
